budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-CAPC4 10-20 structural clock redesign of capc2/capc4 (CLOCKING STANDARD 10-18, safe item 7): LANDED parent from tools/landed_parent/lp.py (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_s81sl_capc5.json). u_rt (boundary insertion 234..298 TT) gets its own clock region ck_rt; trees / ED24 / LD16 / input face registers share region ck_core. The 12 crossings into u_rt (W word, E word, cfg) are ot_pl_land 4-slot rings (+3 edges, fixed, no backpressure); outputs leave through out_regs. Replaces the single core_clk root whose conservative child envelope was TT109.1/FF122.4 (11 compensation variants all failed dual-corner 80).
